tagline.en_US: Inkscape is professional quality vector graphics software which runs on Linux, Mac OS X and Windows desktop computers.

description.en_US: Inkscape is professional vector graphics software designed for creating and editing illustrations and artwork. It provides a rich set of tools to create, manipulate, and render scalable graphic formats. The application offers a complete design environment for working with paths, shapes, and complex digital drawings.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
